description:
ABSLI Assured Income Plus Plan | ABSLI Assured Income Plus is a non-linked, non-participating Life Insurance Savings Plan which offers you income advantages for a Long time along with Loyalty bonuses both of which get added to give you Guaranteed savings. What the real returns of this plan are and what the returns are after 80C Tax exemptions is what we will cover as part of this video.
We will do review and analysis on how much Savings can you get with this plan. We will have also look at the advantages and disadvantages on the plan.

✅ If you liked this video, consider Subscribing my Channel - https://bit.ly/EPMsub

🗒️Link for Excel Sheet - https://everypaisamatters.com/absli-assured-income-plus-plan/

What is assured income plan?
